verdict.rationale: Swell is headless-commerce with a backend API, custom-model/schema introspection, webhooks and CLI, and docs explicitly state you can 'build frontends for storefronts and admin workflows with any framework,' implying API parity for admin-side tasks. However there's no explicit UI-to-API parity guarantee, no OpenAPI spec (404 on probes), and no independent confirmation that every UI action (e.g., theme editing, reporting) has an API equivalent. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation, discoverable OpenAPI/schema spec, and third-party confirmation that all admin UI actions are API-accessible.
